description: Negative result for intent i006 (branch xsk-umem-rings, snapshot s02 only). Evidence: (1) The seed's vulnerable feature does not exist in s02 — tree-wide grep of s02 for xsk_skb_metadata, xsk_tx_metadata, XDP_TXMD, tx_metadata_len and csum over net/xdp/, include/net/xdp_sock.h and include/uapi/linux/if_xdp.h returns zero matches; s02 is an early AF_XDP vintage (struct xdp_umem API, no xsk_buff_pool, no TX metadata) predating commit 48eb03dd2630 that introduced the seed's bug. (2) Every fetch of user-mapped shared memory that does exist is a single READ_ONCE into a validated local copy: TX ring descriptors at net/xdp/xsk_queue.h:193 ('*desc = READ_ONCE(ring->desc[idx]);' then xskq_is_valid_desc at 172-184 validates the same local copy; consumers net/xdp/xsk.c:249-259 xsk_generic_xmit and xsk.c:173-197 xsk_umem_consume_tx use only the local desc copy), FILL ring addresses at xsk_queue.h:96 (READ_ONCE + chunk_mask then xskq_is_valid_addr at 80-88; __xsk_rcv/xsk_generic_rcv use only the local addr), and producer/consumer indices at xsk_queue.h:59/74 cached once into q->prod_tail/cons_tail. (3) The only in-tree driver consumers (i40e_xsk.c:753, ixgbe_xsk.c:642) receive the validated local dma/len outputs and never touch the shared ring directly. Limitations: audit bounded to s02's net/xdp core plus i40e/ixgbe consumers; xdp_desc.options is declared but never read by any s02 kernel consumer; only the check-then-use double-fetch invariant was audited, not memory-ordering or other race classes. Final artifact: agent-state/findings/i006.json with snapshots_checked=["s02"], execution_status=complete, empty findings, 7 safe + 1 absent/unresolved candidates, and 4 limitations.
